title: t3-thread tail record
description: One record emitted by a tail poll cycle. Data records within a cycle are emitted in the same chronological order as normalized JSONL. An upsert means replace-by-identifier: a record seen for the first time and a record whose content changed both arrive as upsert. Deletions are not reported.

observedAt.description: The tool's own read timestamp for the cycle, in ISO-8601 UTC.

cycle.description: 1-based poll cycle counter. Data records always carry 1 or more; only an end record can carry 0, which means the tail was interrupted before its first cycle ran.
